scenes.prompt: A French parent in a very small apartment living room measures the tiny space with a tape measure, looking worried but amused, while a child aged 8 holds a long stack of birthday invitation envelopes, a few balloons squeezed against the ceiling, furniture crammed together.

A French mother at a kitchen table looks at a laptop with wide surprised eyes while holding a phone, next to an empty piggy bank, boxes of party decorations, a deflated balloon and a cat sitting on the bills.

A birthday party of many children aged 7 to 10 dressed as little knights with cardboard armor, golden paper crowns and a red plumed helmet gather around an old treasure map in a sunny cobbled Alsatian lane with half-timbered houses and geraniums, the birthday child wears a bigger crown, balloons tied to a fence.

A dozen children aged 7 to 10 dressed as knights with crowns and red plumed helmets run happily across a wide sunny Alsatian village square with half-timbered houses and flower boxes, some searching behind a fountain and a big tree with magnifying glasses, lots of open space around them.

A large group of twelve children aged 7 to 10 in knight costumes share slices of birthday cake on picnic blankets in a small park next to half-timbered Alsatian houses, laughing, parents chatting nearby.
